description: This file is a shell script for testing the interactive mode of 'git svn dcommit'. It sets up a repository, performs commits, and then runs various test cases simulating user input to the interactive dcommit process, verifying behavior for different responses.

methods.name: svn_cmd
methods.description: Executes SVN commands within the script (assumed to be defined in 'lib-git-svn.sh').

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution, capturing the test description and commands.
